source.shadowPreview: Evaluation mode: models that have not yet beaten the market. Not a recommendation.

disclaimer: PrediGol shows information and analysis; it guarantees no result. Please gamble responsibly (18+).
updateReady: A new version of PrediGol is ready.

long.provider_pending: The provider still reports "{status}" (last read {when}). Not our fault: we keep asking until it closes the match.
long.provider_silent: The provider has said nothing about this match since before it should have ended. We keep asking, the most overdue first.
long.jobs_stalled: Our result jobs are not running: the fault is ours. Check System.
long.provider_conflict: The provider says it finished, with its kick-off still ahead. It is not taken as a result until that is cleared.
long.result_missing: The provider says it finished and we have no score stored: an internal check.

sectionCode.not_started: The match has not started: this does not exist before kick-off.
sectionCode.no_detail_yet: The provider has not sent this match's detail yet.
sectionCode.lineups_usually_60m: Line-ups are usually published about an hour before kick-off.
sectionCode.lineups_not_published: The provider has not published the line-ups yet.
sectionCode.lineups_none: The provider published no line-ups for this match.
sectionCode.no_absences_report: No injury report for this match (that does not mean nobody is missing).
sectionCode.no_table: There is no league table for this competition.
sectionCode.no_form: Neither team has a finished match before this one.
sectionCode.no_h2h: No previous meeting with a result.
sectionCode.no_live_states: No in-play state was recorded for this match.
sectionCode.live_odds_not_kept: In-play prices are shown only while the match is played and are not kept afterwards.
sectionCode.no_market_data: No prices captured for this match yet.
